## TENNIS 40:40 MONITOR · READ BEFORE ENABLING
Ports the strategy from the uploaded document ("Бъдет в гейме счет 40:40 – Да") into a live-match monitor. This is a NOTIFICATION ONLY skeleton — it does not place bets and does not automate stake sizing.

**Why this is diagnostic-only, not production:**
- The source document supports the whole system with ONE match (Nadal vs Fognini). That is an anecdote, not a validated edge. Before trusting this for real money, backtest the underlying claim — "a server who hit deuce in most of their own service games so far in THIS match is likely to hit deuce again in their next service game" — across many historical finals/semifinals, the same way `football-quant/` backtested Dixon-Coles against real closing odds instead of trusting a README.
- The document's staking method ("Правильный Догон" / progressive loss-chasing) is a Martingale-style system: stake increases after a loss to recover it. That is intentionally NOT implemented here. Automating stake progression on an unvalidated in-match heuristic is a fast path to gambler's ruin, not profit. This workflow only ever proposes a flat, fixed stake in its alert text.
- Live, in-match, deuce-level detection needs a POINT-BY-POINT (or at least game-by-game with a "went to deuce" flag) live tennis data feed with sub-minute latency. The API/KEY constants below are placeholders — no provider is wired up. Candidates to evaluate: Sportradar Tennis, Betradar, BetsAPI (b365api) live scores, RapidAPI tennis-live-data. Confirm the provider's ToS allows this use before wiring it in.
- Round metadata (Final / Semifinal) must come from the same provider's fixture/tournament data — the engine below assumes a `round` field ('F' / 'SF') exists on each live match object.

**What you still need to supply:**
1. A real live tennis odds/score provider with per-game server identity and a deuce/game-history array (`match.games[]`).
2. A Telegram chat ID (or swap the final Code node's output for whatever channel you use).
3. A backtest period (see `football-quant/` for the methodology) before trusting the deuce-rate threshold `CFG.MIN_DEUCE_RATE` below — it is currently a guess, not a fitted parameter.
4. A firm decision to keep staking manual and flat. Do not build a "Dogon"/progression staking node.

Until those four are in place, treat every alert this produces as "worth watching," never as a bet.
